blocks.name: create
blocks.text:
on w_mz_ghcl.create
int iCurrent
call super::create
this.sle_1=create sle_1
this.rb_ks=create rb_ks
this.rb_ys=create rb_ys
this.rb_yy=create rb_yy
this.st_1=create st_1
this.ddlb_ghyq=create ddlb_ghyq
this.cbx_zdfp=create cbx_zdfp
this.cbx_bl=create cbx_bl
this.cbx_ck=create cbx_ck
this.cbx_gh=create cbx_gh
this.dw_1=create dw_1
this.gb_1=create gb_1
iCurrent=UpperBound(this.Control)
this.Control[iCurrent+1]=this.sle_1
this.Control[iCurrent+2]=this.rb_ks
this.Control[iCurrent+3]=this.rb_ys
this.Control[iCurrent+4]=this.rb_yy
this.Control[iCurrent+5]=this.st_1
this.Control[iCurrent+6]=this.ddlb_ghyq
this.Control[iCurrent+7]=this.cbx_zdfp
this.Control[iCurrent+8]=this.cbx_bl
this.Control[iCurrent+9]=this.cbx_ck
this.Control[iCurrent+10]=this.cbx_gh
this.Control[iCurrent+11]=this.dw_1
this.Control[iCurrent+12]=this.gb_1
end on

blocks.name: destroy
blocks.text:
on w_mz_ghcl.destroy

destroy(this.cbx_zdfp)
destroy(this.cbx_bl)
destroy(this.cbx_ck)
destroy(this.cbx_gh)
destroy(this.dw_1)
destroy(this.gb_1)
end on
